LanguageData.CVG_Realm_Cap: the seal admits up to realm level {0}
LanguageData.CVG_Realm_Entered: You enter {0}. It will collapse in about {1} days; get out before then.
LanguageData.CVG_Realm_Warning: {0} begins to shake. Less than a day is left before it collapses: whatever is not carried out will be lost with it.
LanguageData.CVG_Realm_Suppressed: The seal of the realm crushes {0}: they are above its limit.
LanguageData.CVG_Realm_Collapsed_Text: {0} folded in on itself like a closing hand. Everyone who was still inside was thrown back to the surface; what they left behind is lost.
LanguageData.CVG_RealmGate_Found_Text: The stone parts to reveal a door of black jade covered in faded formations. Beyond it, the qi is thick and old: the entrance to a secret realm known as {0}.\n\nIt can hold guardians, formation traps and the treasures of a sect that was erased from the chronicles. The realm only admits cultivators up to a certain height, and it collapses a few days after it is entered.
LanguageData.AncientShrineWarning: You have come close to an ancient sanctuary. The air is still, and the sarcophagi inside hold sleepers whose sect was forgotten by everyone but their own dreams.\n\nWhoever wakes them may find allies, or guardians that have never stopped keeping watch. Be careful.
